title: Reproduction Art: Logotype
slide_intent: Give production teams a reliable master at a useful size. Reusing prepared artwork preserves the proportions of a signature through reproduction.
strategic_value: NASA can distribute one recognizable form to many producers through camera-ready copies of the same logotype.
demonstration: Seven black masters descend in size down a shared left edge. The note permits photographic reduction or enlargement of this standalone mark.
practical_value: Choose an appropriately sized master and reproduce it photographically using the instructions at the head of the page.

content_islands.name: Master instructions
content_islands.spec: Set the title, reproduction guidance and supply contact near the upper left.

content_islands.name: Size series
content_islands.spec: Stack seven complete logotypes from largest to smallest down one margin. Leave each master free of surrounding graphics.
